notes.title: v1.2.3 is here! You asked, we delivered!
notes.notes: [p]🧁 [b]Dear Islanders,[/b][/p][p]During this time, we’ve carefully reviewed every piece of negative feedback and suggestion.[/p][p][/p][p]Some of your comments were straightforward — even a bit “brutal” — but we truly appreciate you taking the time to share your honest experience with us.[/p][p][/p][p]This update focuses on fixing the issues you’ve complained about the most, and we’ve also added some brand-new content![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]**✅ Too many clicks? You can now [b]manually input quantities![/b][/p][p]Whether you’re buying, selling, building, or splitting stacks in your backpack — everything now supports manual number input![/p][p][/p][p]No more tapping dozens of times. Inputting numbers is faster, more accurate, and much less hassle![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]✅ Inspiration system too harsh? We’ve optimized it![/b][/p][p]We’ve adjusted the logic behind the Inspiration system so that the mid-to-late game maintains a smooth and enjoyable pace.[/p][p][/p][p]High Inspiration no longer means high penalties. We’ve redesigned the challenge mechanics to make them motivating rather than discouraging.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]✅ Poor sea-combing experience? We’ve rebuilt the Trident![/b][/p][p]The trident now feels smoother, with reduced wind-up and more stable hits.[/p][p][/p][p]Knockback effects have been significantly reduced, so you won’t get bounced halfway across the beach by those crabs anymore![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]🐠 New Feature: Fish Tank Decoration System[/b][/p][p]You can now freely place decorations in your fish tank to create your own underwater world:[/p][p][/p][p]Place pebbles, corals, bubble makers, and more — with even more fun decorations coming soon![/p][p][/p][p]Decorations can be combined and layered, allowing every player to design a unique little aquatic scene![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]🧡 [b]If you feel this update has truly improved your experience,[/b][/p][p]we’d love it if you could update your previous review or leave us a positive rating.[/p][p][/p][p]Your support means the world to us 🙏![/p][p][/p][p]We’ll keep polishing every detail to make this island a place where you’ll want to stay, live, and slowly fall in love with.[/p][p][/p][p]— [b]The Little Life Dev Team[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081515/d2f874a3e8b5c2f5db177464a1aab48221703a02.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081515/edb3805fe6a984d424609bdcccf8d179a9e4d145.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Couple Outfit Try-On, Clothing Preferences & Fish Tanks!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We’ve brought you a warm and practical batch of new features this time 🌟

[b]👗 1. Character Clothing Preference System[/b]
Every character now has their own fashion taste!
When you gift them clothes, they’ll react with unique dialogue based on their preferences.
And this is just the beginning — more clothing-related interactions are on the way!

[b]🐠 2. New Feature: Fish Tanks[/b]
Add a peaceful touch to your Little Life!
You can now buy fish tanks from the AKE A shop and start your aquarium journey.
More fish species and decorations will be supported in future updates!

[b]💑 3. Couple Outfit Try-On Feature[/b]
You can now gift outfits to your partner and invite them to try them on!
If they like it, they’ll add it to their personal wardrobe.
Every day, they’ll dress up in different styles based on their mood and clothing collection — showing off more of their personality!

⸻

We hope you enjoy the update!
If you love these new features, don’t forget to share your favorite outfit combos or fish tank setups in the comments~ 🐟💕

notes.title: New outfits and styles!And some plans.
notes.notes:
Long time no see, everyone! This update brings new outfits, new designer hairstyles, and bug fixes. It’s been nearly four years since Little Life was launched. Over these years, the game has faced many challenges, but I’ve never given up. I’ve persisted with consistent updates because I firmly believe Little Life still holds untapped, unique potential—and many players agree!

Next, I’ll focus on enriching character storylines, marriage systems, and post-marriage happiness. I’ll also start learning how to integrate mod support (e.g., Steam Workshop) to bring even more creativity to Little Life.

[h3]New Additions:[/h3]
1.Added new outfits: Seventh Evening Dress and Seventh Headpiece.
2.Added two new designer hairstyles.
3.Added vehicle recovery during Li Yi’s work hours.
4.Released Fu Xing’s exclusive storyline.
5.Expanded Ding Wu’s dialogue options.

[h3]Fixes & Optimizations:[/h3]
1.Extended the Traveling Merchant’s stay duration and increased their spawn rate.
2.Fixed an issue where the Traveling Merchant didn’t sell the Back Sea Pearl.
